stories.title: Claude Mythos: Anthropic's most powerful model confirmed — cybersecurity first, no public date
stories.summary: A data leak on March 26, 2026 exposed internal Anthropic docs describing Claude Mythos as 'by far the most powerful AI model we have ever developed,' positioned above the Opus tier. Anthropic confirmed training is complete and it is being trialed with cybersecurity-focused early access partners first. No public release date has been announced.
key_facts: Training complete as of late March 2026
Confirmed via internal document leak March 26, 2026

stories.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro leads 13 of 16 major benchmarks at one-third the API cost of GPT-5.4
stories.summary: Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro now leads 13 of 16 major AI benchmarks and ties GPT-5.4 Pro on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — at roughly one-third the API cost. Google also released Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at $0.25/M input tokens, delivering 2.5x faster response times and 45% faster output generation than previous efficiency models.
key_facts: Ties GPT-5.4 Pro on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

stories.title: MCP crosses 97 million installs; Linux Foundation takes it under open governance
stories.summary: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol crossed 97 million installs in March 2026. Every major AI provider now ships MCP-compatible tooling. The Linux Foundation announced it will take MCP under open governance — making it a vendor-neutral standard for agentic AI tool integration.
key_facts: All major AI providers now ship MCP-compatible tooling
Linux Foundation adopts MCP under open governance
De facto standard for agentic AI tool integration

stories.title: OpenAI surpasses $25B annualized revenue; Anthropic at $19B; IPO signals emerging
stories.summary: OpenAI has crossed $25 billion in annualized revenue and is reportedly taking early steps toward a public listing, potentially as soon as late 2026. Anthropic approaches $19 billion. GPT-5.4 Thinking scored 83% on GDPVal — a benchmark measuring performance on economically valuable tasks at or above human expert level.
key_facts: GPT-5.4 Thinking: 83% on GDPVal (human expert threshold)

stories.title: Oracle cuts 20,000–30,000 employees to redirect $8–10B toward AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Oracle announced plans to cut 20,000 to 30,000 employees and redirect $8 to $10 billion toward AI infrastructure investment. This is the clearest signal yet of legacy enterprise tech companies restructuring headcount to fund the AI transition.
key_facts: Pattern: legacy tech restructuring for AI pivot

stories.title: Utah grants AI authority to autonomously renew drug prescriptions
stories.summary: Utah became the first US state to grant AI systems the authority to autonomously renew drug prescriptions — moving beyond diagnostic assistance to actual treatment decisions. This represents a regulatory threshold crossing for AI in healthcare.
key_facts: First US state to authorize AI for prescription renewal
Autonomous renewal, not just diagnostic assistance
Regulatory milestone for AI in healthcare

stories.title: Meta Llama 4 Maverick: 400B params, 10M context — free open-weight frontier
stories.summary: Meta's Llama 4 Maverick (400B parameters, 10 million token context window) is the strongest open-weight model available and runs free on your own infrastructure. Open source is no longer a performance compromise versus proprietary APIs.
key_facts: Runs on own infrastructure, no API cost
Competes seriously with proprietary flagship models

signals: Agentic AI has moved from demo to production across all major labs
Open-source model quality now challenges proprietary closed APIs — cost economics shifting
AI revenue at frontier labs growing faster than headcount: OpenAI $25B, Anthropic $19B
MCP becoming the 'USB standard' for AI tool integration — vendor neutrality now confirmed
First regulatory crossing in healthcare AI: Utah autonomous prescriptions
